hits.about: Mag Eye is a residential complex from the developer MAG Property Development. The complex includes studios, one- to two-bedroom apartments and townhouses with two to four bedrooms. The residences have living rooms, kitchen areas, bathrooms and walk-in closets. The apartments are distinguished by high-quality finishes, furniture and household appliances. The developer paid special attention to the interior and exterior design of the project. The townhouses are equipped with panoramic windows with scenic views. Some apartments also have laundry facilities and staff quarters. The residences have balconies, and the townhouses have a spacious backyard. A comfortable temperature is provided by the central air conditioning system. The kitchens are equipped with refrigerators, ovens, dishwashers. Built-in wardrobes skillfully fit into the interior, providing reasonable zoning of the premises. The complex provides many amenities and services, including: covered parking for residents and outdoor parking for guests, 24-hour security and video surveillance, modern heating and ventilation systems, landscaped areas for sports and recreation, children's playgrounds, gym, swimming pools. Mag Eye is conveniently located at the intersection of Meydan Road, Al Khail Road and Sheikh Zayed Road, which provide direct routes to other parts of the emirate. There are kindergartens, schools, supermarkets and medical facilities within walking distance. Dubai International Airport is a 20-minute drive from the residences.
